content: The test image shows split soybean stems with bleached white internal tissue and prominent **black sclerotia** — large irregular black masses embedded within the stem. This is the hallmark of White Mold.

The reference images show white fluffy mold and bleached stems, but the test image specifically shows the **interior of split stems revealing large black sclerotia** — exactly matching the White Mold description: *"Characteristic black sclerotia embedded within white fluffy mold on stems and inside stems"* and *"Dry dead stems develop a bleached white appearance."*

The black irregular masses inside the bleached white stem are the definitive diagnostic sign of White Mold (*Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*).
